description: IFTM University is established under the IFTM University Act No. 24 of 2010 and is located at Lodhipur Rajput on Delhi Road near Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. Its official catalogue lists diploma, undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across management, pharmacy, engineering, sciences, biotechnology, agriculture, law, education and humanities.

agent_notes: Government listing was established in both supplied 2025 NIRF directories; the matching rows identify IFTM University in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh.
Normal TLS first returned the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET requests were then retried with curl --insecure only for the expected NIRF and iftmuniversity.ac.in hosts.

The official admissions catalogue currently exposes 8 diploma programmes, 37 UG programmes, 41 PG programmes and 28 Ph.D. specializations. The homepage also contains older summary wording about 54 programmes; the current category tables were used for exact programme names.

The official navigation exposes diploma, UG, PG and doctoral catalogues but no active certificate-programme catalogue; short-term/value-added course links were excluded because they are not presented as degree, diploma, certificate or doctoral admissions programmes.
